description:
This video was produced by Shasta who’s ears you can see in the background 🐺

Novelty is a helpful tool for starting a habit and finding the motivation to want to do it however it is not a prerequisite for plastic change.
transcript: The gap between two neurons is 20 nanometers wide. It is so incredibly small that it's invisible to the naked eye. Yet in that tiny little gap lies our ability to rewire our thoughts, our habits, and our behaviors. That's the jump you need to make every day. So if you're somebody that keeps stopping and starting and can never quite get it right, that tells me that you're not being consistent enough. Because under Hebbian law, if two neurons fire consecutively within a specific time frame, they will wire together. It really is that simple. The brain only cares about repetition. So if you can get really good at just putting one foot in front of the other and stop worrying about the bigger picture, you will eventually change into the person you said you were going to be. And you can do that within three to six months.
